40023157.author: पदार्थः
40023157.content: विसृज्य having sent away, लक्ष्मणं Lakshmana, रामः Rama, दुःखशोकसमन्वितः filled with sorrow and grief, पुरोधसं to the chief priest, मन्त्रिणः to the ministers, च and, नैगमान् to the citizens, च and, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् said.

40023157.author: Translation
40023157.content: Having sent Lakshmana away, Rama, filled with sorrow and grief, spoke these words to his chief priest, ministers, and citizens.

40023158.author: पदार्थः
40023158.content: अद्य today, राज्ये in the kingdom, अभिषेक्ष्यामि I shall anoint, भरतं Bharata, धर्मवत्सलम् devoted to dharma, अयोध्यायाः of Ayodhya, पतिं the lord, वीरं the brave one, ततः then, यास्यामि I shall go, अहं I, वनम् to the forest.

40023158.author: Translation
40023158.content: Rama declared, "Today I shall install the righteous and brave Bharata as the ruler of Ayodhya, and then I myself shall go to the forest."

40023159.author: पदार्थः
40023159.content: प्रवेशयत bring in, सम्भारान् preparations, मा let not, भूत् happen, कालस्य of time, पर्ययः a lapse, अद्यैव today itself, अहं I, गमिष्यामि will go, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, गतां attained, गतिम् the path.

40023159.author: Translation
40023159.content: Bring in the preparations, let there be no delay, for today itself I will follow the path that Lakshmana has taken.

40023160.author: पदार्थः
40023160.content: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, राघवेण by Rama, उक्तं spoken, सर्वाः all, प्रकृतयः the subjects, भृशम् greatly, मूर्धभिः with their heads, प्रणताः bowed down, भूमौ on the ground, गतसत्त्वाः as if lifeless, इव as if, अभवन् became.

40023160.author: Translation
40023160.content: Having heard those words spoken by Rama, all the subjects greatly bowed their heads to the ground, as if they had lost their very life.

40023161.author: पदार्थः
40023161.content: भरतश्च Bharata also, विसञ्ज्ञः unconscious, अभूत् became, श्रुत्वा having heard, रामस्य of Rama, भाषितम् the words, राज्यं kingship, विगर्हयामास condemned, राघवं to Rama, च and, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40023161.author: Translation
40023161.content: Bharata also became unconscious upon hearing Rama's words, and condemning kingship, he spoke these words to Rama.

40023162.author: पदार्थः
40023162.content: सत्येन by truth, अहं I, शपे swear, राजन् O King, स्वर्गलोके in the heavenly world, न not, च and, एव indeed, हि surely, न not, कामये desire, यथा just as, राज्यं kingship, त्वां you, विना without, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus.

40023162.author: Translation
40023162.content: O King, I swear by truth, and indeed by the heavenly world, that I do not desire kingship without you, O delight of the Raghus.

40023163.author: पदार्थः
40023163.content: इमौ these two, कुशलवौ Kusha and Lava, राजन् O King, अभिषिञ्च enthrone, नराधिप O lord of men, कोसलेषु in Kosala, कुशं Kusha, वीरम् the brave, उत्तरेषु in the northern regions, तथा and, लवम् Lava.

40023163.author: Translation
40023163.content: O King, O lord of men, enthrone these two, Kusha and Lava; Kusha, the brave, in Kosala, and similarly Lava in the northern regions.

40023164.author: पदार्थः
40023164.content: शत्रुघ्नस्य of Shatrughna, तु and, गच्छन्तु let them go, दूताः messengers, त्वरितविक्रमाः swift-footed, इदं this, गमनम् departure, अस्माकं our, स्वर्गाय for heaven, आख्यातु let them announce, मा not, चिरम् long.

40023164.author: Translation
40023164.content: Let swift messengers go to Shatrughna and without delay inform him of our departure to heaven.

40023165.author: पदार्थः
40023165.content: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, भरतेन by Bharata, उक्तं spoken, दृष्ट्वा having seen, च and, अपि also, अधोमुखान् downcast, पौरान् citizens, दुःखेन by sorrow, सन्तप्तान् distressed, वसिष्ठः Vasishtha, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40023165.author: Translation
40023165.content: Having heard what Bharata said and seeing the citizens distressed and downcast with sorrow, Vasishtha spoke these words.

40023166.author: पदार्थः
40023166.content: वत्स dear son, राम Rama, इमाः these, पश्य behold, धरणीं to the ground, प्रकृतीः subjects, गताः fallen, ज्ञात्वा having known, एषां their, ईप्सितं desired, कार्यं action, मा not, च and, एषां their, विप्रियं displeasure, कृथाः cause.

40023166.author: Translation
40023166.content: Vasishtha said, "Dear Rama, behold these subjects fallen to the ground; understanding their desire, do not cause them any displeasure."

40023167.author: पदार्थः
40023167.content: वसिष्ठस्य of Vasishtha, तु and, वाक्येन by the words, उत्थाप्य having raised up, प्रकृतीजनम् the people, किं what, करोमि shall I do, इति thus, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha (Rama), सर्वाः to all, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40023167.author: Translation
40023167.content: And by the words of Vasishtha, Rama, having raised up the people, spoke to all, asking, "What shall I do?"

40023168.author: पदार्थः
40023168.content: ततः then, सर्वाः all, प्रकृतयः subjects, रामं to Rama, वचनम् words, अब्रुवन् spoke, गच्छन्तम् one who is going, अनुगच्छामः we will follow, यत्र where, राम Rama, गमिष्यसि you will go.

40023168.author: Translation
40023168.content: Then all the subjects spoke to Rama, saying, "We will follow you, wherever you, Rama, will go."

40023169.author: पदार्थः
40023169.content: पौरेषु towards the citizens, यदि if, ते your, प्रीतिः affection, यदि if, स्नेहः love, हि indeed, अनुत्तमः unsurpassed, सपुत्रदाराः with children and wives, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, समागच्छाम let us go together, सत्पथम् on the righteous path.

40023169.author: Translation
40023169.content: O Rama, if you truly have unsurpassed affection and love for your citizens, then let us all, with our children and wives, accompany you on your path.

40023170.author: पदार्थः
40023170.content: तपोवनम् to the hermitage, वा or, दुर्गम् to a fortress, वा or, नदीम् to a river, अम्भोनिधिम् to the ocean, तथा similarly, वयम् we, ते by you, यदि if, न not, त्याज्याः to be abandoned, सर्वान् all, नः us, नय lead, ईश्वर O Lord.

40023170.author: Translation
40023170.content: O Lord, if we are not to be abandoned by you, then lead all of us, whether to a hermitage, a fortress, a river, or the ocean.

40023171.author: पदार्थः
40023171.content: एषा this, नः our, परमा supreme, प्रीतिः affection, एषः this, नः our, परमः supreme, वरः boon, हृद्गता residing in the heart, नः our, सदा always, प्रीतिः affection, तव your, अनुगमने in following, नृप O King.

40023171.author: Translation
40023171.content: O King, this is our supreme affection and our greatest wish, for our hearts are always filled with love for following you.

40023172.author: पदार्थः
40023172.content: पौराणाम् of the citizens, दृढभक्तिम् firm devotion, च and, बाढम् certainly, इति thus, एव indeed, सः he, अब्रवीत् said, स्वकृतान्तम् his own destiny, च and, अन्ववेक्ष्य having considered, तस्मिन् on that, अहनि day, राघवः Rama.

40023172.author: Translation
40023172.content: Having observed the firm devotion of the citizens and considering his own destined end, Rama said, "Certainly, yes," on that very day.

40023173.author: पदार्थः
40023173.content: कोसलेषु in Kosala, कुशम् Kusha, वीरम् the brave, उत्तरेषु in the northern regions, तथा similarly, लवम् Lava, अभिषिच्य having consecrated, महात्मानौ the two great-souled ones, उभौ both, रामः Rama, कुशीलवौ Kusha and Lava.

40023173.author: Translation
40023173.content: Rama, having consecrated both the brave and great-souled Kusha in Kosala and similarly Lava in the northern regions, completed his arrangements.

40023174.author: पदार्थः
40023174.content: अभिषिक्तौ having been consecrated, सुतौ sons, अङ्के on his lap, प्रतिष्ठाप्य having established, पुरे in the city, ततः then, परिष्वज्य having embraced, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed one, मूर्ध्नि on the head, उपाघ्राय having smelled, च and, असकृत् repeatedly.

40023174.author: Translation
40023174.content: Then, the mighty-armed Rama, having consecrated his two sons and established them in the city, repeatedly embraced them and kissed them on their heads.

40023175.author: पदार्थः
40023175.content: रथानाम् of chariots, तु indeed, सहस्राणि thousands, नागानाम् of elephants, अयुतानि ten thousands, च and, दशायुतानि ten ten-thousands, च and, अश्वानाम् of horses, एकैकस्य to each one, धनम् wealth, ददौ he gave.

40023175.author: Translation
40023175.content: He gave to each of his sons thousands of chariots, ten thousands of elephants, and one hundred thousand horses as wealth.

40023176.author: पदार्थः
40023176.content: बहुरत्नौ having many jewels, बहुधनौ having much wealth, हृष्टपुष्टजनावृतौ surrounded by happy and well-nourished people, स्वे to their own, पुरे city, प्रेषयामास he sent, भ्रातरौ the two brothers, तु indeed, कुशीलवौ Kusha and Lava.

40023176.author: Translation
40023176.content: He then sent the two brothers, Kusha and Lava, to their respective cities, each endowed with many jewels, much wealth, and surrounded by happy and prosperous people.

40023177.author: पदार्थः
40023177.content: अभिषिच्य having consecrated, सुतौ sons, वीरौ heroic, प्रतिष्ठाप्य having established, पुरे in the city, तदा then, दूतान् messengers, सम्प्रेषयामास he sent, शत्रुघ्नाय to Shatrughna, महात्मने the great-souled one.

40023177.author: Translation
40023177.content: After consecrating his heroic sons and establishing them in their cities, he then dispatched messengers to the great-souled Shatrughna. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे सप्तोत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। 107 ।। Thus ends the hundred and seventh sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
